description: This file defines the interface and classes for a network probe component within the WPEFramework plugin system. It includes classes for handling Web requests, responses, and datagram broadcasting, as well as managing probe instances and their network communication logic.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class managing network probing, broadcasting, and handling Web requests/responses within the plugin.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a network probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security attributes.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web request data for network transmission.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Handles incoming Web requests and responses, manages request validation and response creation.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles broadcasting of network probe requests via UDP datagrams, including request creation and response handling.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web request data into a network data frame.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a Web request when a partial request is received.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in the network channel state.

methods.name: CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a Web response based on incoming request data.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping request via broadcast to discover network probes.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data over UDP datagram, managing multiple destinations.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a network request string with optional security signature.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Reports a discovered probe's URL, latency, model, and security status.
